verdict.rationale: Cline's web-based task board offers per-card worktrees, auto-commit, dependency chains and parallel agent execution, plus CLI cron scheduling via a 'hub' and headless CI/CD runs (cline-docs-5, cline-docs-13, cline-docs-2/3/4, cline-docs-17), which supports delegating background, longer-running tasks. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'isolated cloud environment' (e.g., sandboxed VM/container infra) distinct from local worktrees or self-hosted CI runners. Missing for 10: explicit cloud-hosted sandbox/isolation details, independent hands-on confirmation of the task-board/cloud execution feature.
